newsitem.title: USA: Staffmark sees shr at or over expectations.
newsitem.headline: Staffmark sees shr at or over expectations.

text.p: StaffMark Inc said on Friday that it expects to meet or exceed expectations of $0.18 a share in the fourth quarter.

Staffmark, which conducted an initial public offering in September, said it issued the statement in response to stock market concerns over margin pressures with home health care services and national accounts.

"Home health care does not represnet a material portion of our specialty medical business," StaffMark said. The company said that Medicare-related factors have not hurt its specialty medical business.
Staffmark said gross margins have increased in 1996 compared with 1995 and remain strong in the fourth quarter.
